verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Pods are billed by the second with no ingress/egress fees, and Serverless is billed per-second from worker start to stop, rounded up to nearest second, with scale-to-zero for idle workers—directly matching the story. Minor gap: no independent/community corroboration of billing accuracy in practice. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of per-second billing accuracy, edge-case rounding details.
